Designed and built REST APIs in Python and FastAPI for a shipment tracking service used by 25 internal teams, handling 1.5M requests per day with p99 latency under 150 ms.
Added a Redis cache and PostgreSQL index tuning to the tracking service, reducing database load by 40% and cutting median response time from 190 ms to 70 ms.
Wrote unit and integration tests with pytest and Testcontainers, raising coverage of the tracking service from 48% to 85% and catching two regressions in the CI pipeline before release.
Wrote runbooks and onboarding notes for the tracking service and presented the caching design at a team knowledge-sharing session for new hires.
Built a Python and Apache Airflow pipeline that loaded 20 GB of daily event logs into a cloud data warehouse, replacing manual exports and giving analysts hourly instead of daily data.
Created SQL dashboards for the customer support team that tracked the ticket backlog across 900 accounts and helped the team plan staffing for busy weeks.
Joined the on-call rotation, triaged pipeline alerts and wrote postmortems for two incidents, which led to new data quality checks that halved failed nightly jobs.
Built a web app with FastAPI and PostgreSQL that matches students into study groups by course and schedule, serving 600 weekly users from a Docker container on a small cloud server.
Implemented full-text search over 10,000 course sections with PostgreSQL indexes, returning results in under 60 ms with filters for time, instructor and campus.
Set up GitHub Actions with linting, type checks and automated tests, so every pull request was verified before merge and deployments became repeatable.
Developed an Android app in Kotlin that reminds users to water and repot plants, with offline storage and background notifications that respect battery limits.
Trained a small image classifier that recognizes 30 common houseplants on device, reaching 88% accuracy on a held-out set of 2,000 synthetic test photos.
Wrote a chat bot in TypeScript and Node.js that posts campus event reminders to student group channels, with a small admin page for organizers to schedule announcements.
Interviewed twelve student organizers to shape the reminder schedule, and grew the bot to 40 groups and about 1,500 members over one semester.
